common.footer: Production deploys require human approval. Do not publish to production automatically.

home.eyebrow: Stage 6A + N · admin import and notice copy
home.headline: Welcome to the Club management system
home.lead: Visitors can open the public match schedule without signing in and add a match to a calendar. After parents sign in, training and competitions are listed separately; the same series can be attended or declined in one tap. Admins and assigned coaches record 1–5 scores for match situations and player traits. Ability details and credits are never shown on public pages.
home.sampleBody: Current language: English. Use the language switcher above to see Traditional Chinese or Japanese strings.
home.stackSupabase: Supabase phone OTP, profiles, multi-role, org master data, guardian links, training sessions, prepaid credits, player assessments, public matches, and RLS
home.stackPwa: PWA: web app manifest and basic meta
home.envConfigured: Public Supabase variables are present. Sign-in talks to this project (anon key only).
home.envMissing: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is not set. The homepage still previews, but sign-in cannot work.

auth.title: Sign in with your phone
auth.lead: We send a one-time SMS code. On first successful sign-in we create a profile and assign the default parent role.
auth.phoneHint: Taiwan numbers can be entered in local 09… format; we convert them to E.164. Example: 0912 345 678.
auth.codeSent: If SMS is configured, a code was sent. Enter it before it expires.
auth.codeSentTo: The code will be sent to {phone}
auth.smsBlocked: SMS could not be sent. Enable Phone Auth in the Supabase Dashboard and configure an SMS provider (for example Twilio). You can still enter a code to test the error path, but you cannot complete login until SMS works.

errors.notConfigured: Public Supabase environment variables are missing, so sign-in is unavailable.
errors.smsNotConfigured: SMS is not configured or the message failed to send.
errors.rateLimit: Too many requests. Please wait and try again.
errors.invalidOtp: That code is not valid. You are not signed in.
errors.expiredOtp: That code has expired. You are not signed in. Request a new one.

app.title: Club dashboard
app.welcome: Parents can request a link to a child, register approved children for training or competitions, see prepaid session credits, and read ability assessments for linked children. Anyone can open the public match schedule and add it to a calendar. Admins manage teams, players, coaches, bindings, sessions, matches, claims, assessments, data import, and notice copy. Coaches can open assigned rosters, take attendance, and record assessments for players on their teams.
app.profileMissing: Missing (sign in again, or confirm the database migration was applied)
app.noDashboardRole: This account does not have a parent, coach, or admin role.
app.playerNote: The player role is reserved for later stages. There is no player login experience yet.

children.title: Players / children
children.body: Request a link to an existing player. After an admin approves, they appear here.

sessions.title: Training
sessions.body: Register an approved child for regular or special training. Attend or decline a whole series in one tap.

competitions.title: Competitions
competitions.body: Register an approved child for cup, league, and friendly matches. Same-title fixtures are grouped so you can RSVP the series together.

courses.title: Courses
courses.body: Course enrollment and schedules are not available yet.

squads.title: Assigned roster
squads.body: Read-only list of players on teams assigned to you.

teams.title: Teams
teams.body: Create and edit training squads and age bands.

players.title: Players
players.body: Create player records with English given and family names, at least one of Traditional Chinese or Japanese, date of birth, team, and jersey number.

coaches.title: Coaches
coaches.body: Link an existing signed-in profile, then assign teams.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.body: Mark present, excused, or unexcused on assigned-team sessions. Insufficient credits block present.

assessments.title: Ability assessments
assessments.body: Coaches and admins record 1–5 scores for four match situations and four traits. Approved guardians can read only their linked children.

members.title: Members
members.body: Parents request a link to an existing player; admins approve on the bindings page. Promote extra admins in the Supabase Dashboard.

bindings.title: Guardian bindings
bindings.body: Approve, reject, or revoke parent requests to link to a player.

adminSessions.title: Training sessions
adminSessions.body: Create titled regular and special training sessions. Weekly series use selected weekdays. Cup, league, and friendly matches belong under Matches.

adminMatches.title: Public matches
adminMatches.body: Create cup, league, and friendly matches, publish a lineup of display names and jersey numbers, and set the result.

adminImport.title: Data import
adminImport.body: Download CSV/Excel templates, preview rows, then confirm create-only imports for players, coaches, and matches. Paste a public match URL to fill a draft.

publicMatches.title: Public schedule
publicMatches.body: Visitor schedule: published cup, league, and friendly matches, results, and lineups. Parent signup is on Competitions.

credits.title: Credits and top-up
credits.body: See remaining prepaid credits for approved children and submit a bank-transfer claim.

claims.title: Transfer claims
claims.body: Review parent bank-transfer claims. Approving credits the player balance.

creditsAdmin.title: Credits and packages
creditsAdmin.body: Maintain the package catalog, adjust balances, and write transfer instructions (never commit a real account to git).

adminNote.title: Role promotion
adminNote.body: There is no in-app backdoor. Add an admin row for the user in the Dashboard user_roles table. Linking a coach also grants the coach role.

access.deniedBodyAdmin: Admin pages are limited to club admins. Coaches can open the roster; parents can request a child link from My children.
access.deniedBodyRoster: The roster is limited to assigned coaches and admins. Parents without those roles stay on the dashboard.
access.deniedBodyAssessments: Only an assigned coach or admin can create or edit an assessment. Approved guardians can read their child’s history.

admin.title: Admin
admin.lead: Organization master data for this club. No real personal data is seeded.
admin.teamsBody: 梯隊 are roster bands (training). 隊伍 are competition sides (matches). Create each separately. Deactivate, reactivate, or delete an empty unit from this list.
admin.playersBody: Each player needs names, a date of birth, exactly one 梯隊, and a jersey on that 梯隊. Continuing trainees may join up to two 隊伍 with different layer keys. Birth eligibility is enforced. Jersey numbers are unique within one 梯隊 or one 隊伍.
admin.coachesBody: The person must sign in once so a profile exists. Then you link them here and assign teams. That also grants the coach role.
admin.bindingsBody: Parents search for an existing player with team + jersey or birth date + name, then request a link. Approve, reject, or revoke an approved link here. Pending, rejected, and revoked parents cannot read that child’s record.
admin.sessionsBody: Create titled regular or special training on 梯隊 only. Multi-select 梯隊 to create one independent series or session per 梯隊 with the same details. Special is one occurrence. Regular uses selected weekdays plus an end date or a per-weekday week count. Cup, league, and friendly matches belong on Admin → Matches and attach to 隊伍. The default admin view is a month calendar. Inactive hides new parent signup; soft-delete keeps registrations and Q&A. Registration is auto-approved. There is no capacity limit in this stage.
admin.matchesBody: Announce cup, league, and friendly matches on the public schedule. Multi-select 隊伍 to create one independent fixture set per 隊伍 with the same title and kickoffs. Choose who appears on the published lineup (display name and jersey only). Cancelled matches are hidden from visitors, not listed as cancelled. Writes are admin-only.
admin.importBody: Upload Excel or CSV, preview valid and invalid rows, then confirm. Nothing is written on upload alone. Players and coaches are create-only; duplicates block that row. Matches attach to 隊伍 and stay unpublished unless the file says otherwise. URL assist only fills a draft.
admin.teamsEmptyBody: Create the first 梯隊 or 隊伍. Nothing is preloaded.
admin.ageSquadsEmptyBody: Create a 梯隊 (age squad) for training. Nothing is preloaded.
admin.competitionTeamsEmptyBody: Create a 隊伍 (competition side) for matches. Nothing is preloaded.
admin.playersEmptyBody: Create a team first, then add players. Do not enter real personal data on shared staging unless you intend to.
admin.coachesEmptyBody: Ask the coach to sign in once, then link their profile.
admin.playersNeedTeamBody: A player needs exactly one 梯隊 and a jersey unique on that 梯隊. Continuing trainees may join up to two 隊伍 with different layer keys.
admin.teamRosterEmptyBody: Create a player and assign this squad plus a jersey number.
admin.bindingsEmptyBody: When a parent requests a link, it shows up here for approval.
admin.teamLifecycleBody: Deactivating hides this squad from parent link search; existing memberships stay. Permanent delete is allowed only when there are no active memberships. Ended memberships and coach assignments are removed with the team.
admin.deleteTeamConfirm: Permanently delete “{name}”? This also removes {inactive} ended memberships and {coaches} coach assignments. Player records are not deleted. This cannot be undone.
admin.deleteTeamBlockedConfirm: Cannot delete “{name}”: {count} active players remain. Move them to another team or end those memberships first.
admin.deleteBlockedActive: This team still has {count} active players, so it cannot be deleted. Move them to another team or end those memberships first.
admin.bulkCreateMatchBody: Create many unpublished cup, league, or friendly shells for each selected team. Leave opponent blank when the fixture is not known yet. Edit each match later to add the opponent, publish, and set the lineup.
admin.rosterEmptyBody: When a parent registers an approved child, they appear here.
admin.sessionsEmptyBody: Create a team first, then add a training session.
admin.matchesEmptyBody: Create a cup, league, or friendly match, or attach a public page to an existing match session.
admin.sessionsFilterEmptyBody: Try other kinds or teams, or include deleted sessions to see history.
admin.filterKindsHint: Leave all unchecked to show every kind on this page.
admin.filterTeamsHint: Leave all unchecked to show every 梯隊 or 隊伍 on this page.
admin.multiTeamNone: Could not create for any selected team.
admin.listWindowEmptyBody: Load more or see earlier dates. Filters still apply.
admin.calendarEmptyDayBody: Pick another day, or create a session. Filters apply to the whole month.
admin.calendarEmptyWeekBody: Pick another week, or create a session. Filters apply to the whole month.
admin.sessionDeletedBanner: This session is soft-deleted. Parents cannot newly sign up. Existing registrations and Q&A stay visible here.
admin.softDeleteSessionConfirm: Delete “{title}”? Parents will no longer see it for new signup. Registrations and Q&A are kept.
admin.softDeleteOccurrenceConfirm: Delete this occurrence of “{title}”? Other dates in the series stay. Parents cannot newly sign up for this date. Registrations and Q&A are kept.
admin.softDeleteSeriesConfirm: Delete every occurrence in the series that includes “{title}”? Parents will no longer see those sessions for new signup. Registrations and Q&A are kept.
admin.noticesBody: Generate short LINE-group text and app deep links for a 梯隊, a 隊伍, or parents already registered on a session. Copy only — this app does not send LINE, SMS, or push.

roster.title: Roster
roster.lead: Players on teams assigned to you. This list is read-only.
roster.emptyBody: When an admin assigns you to a team that has players, they will show up here.
roster.sessionsLead: Read-only list of sessions on teams assigned to you, including who registered.
roster.sessionsEmptyBody: When an admin creates a session on a team assigned to you, it will show up here.

org.nameCjkHint: Fill Traditional Chinese and/or Japanese. At least one of the two is required.
org.seasonStartLabel: Season start used for this calculation: {date} (cutover every 15 August, Asia/Taipei)
org.continuesTrainingHint: Only continuing trainees can be added to 隊伍. Existing 隊伍 memberships are kept if you uncheck this.
org.jerseyHint: 1–99. Unique on this 隊伍; the same number may be used on another unit.
org.jerseyHintSquad: 1–99. Unique on this 梯隊; the same number may be used on a 隊伍.
org.ageBandMismatch: The player’s suggested age band does not match this team’s band. You can still save.
org.ageBandNotAllowed: This 梯隊 does not match the player’s birth-age roster band.
org.playingUpNote: Dual 隊伍 membership uses birth eligibility and layer_key, not ladder play-up.
org.membershipRuleHint: Exactly one 梯隊. At most two 隊伍; same layer_key (e.g. 藍+白) is forbidden. Birth eligibility is required. Dual rules do not apply to 梯隊.
org.linkCoachHint: The user must already exist (they should sign in once). Linking creates a coach record and grants the coach role. Then assign teams.
org.noLinkableProfiles: There are no other profiles to link. The person needs to sign in with phone OTP once, then reload this page.

children.title: My children
children.lead: Request a link to a player the club already created. An admin must approve before you can see their details here and register them for training or competitions.
children.emptyChildrenBody: After an admin approves a request, the player’s name, date of birth, team, and jersey appear here.
children.emptyRequestsBody: Use the form below. You will not see a full club roster — only a match if your search is specific enough.
children.requestLead: Use exact team and jersey, or date of birth plus part of a name. Both together narrows the result further.
children.searchHint: The app does not list every player. Fill one complete search (team + jersey, or birth date + name), or fill both.
children.searchIdentityHint: Name needs at least two characters. It is matched against English given/family and Traditional Chinese or Japanese names.
children.confirmHint: Check this is your child, then submit. Until an admin approves, you cannot open their record from My children.
children.parentNoteHint: Optional. For example how the club can recognise you. Do not paste extra contact details the club does not already have.
children.noMatchDetails: Player details are shown only while this link is approved.

sessions.title: Training
sessions.lead: Register an approved child for regular and special training on their 梯隊. Cup, league, and friendly signup is on Competitions, attached to 隊伍. Signup is auto-approved. Inactive or deleted sessions are not listed. You cannot cancel within 24 hours of the start. Add a note on the session detail page. Switch between calendar and list views.
sessions.emptyUpcomingBody: When an admin creates a session for your child’s team, it appears here. Inactive, deleted, or ended sessions are hidden.
sessions.needApprovedChild: Link a child and wait for admin approval before you can register for sessions.
sessions.emptyRegistrationsBody: Pick a session above and register a child.
sessions.registerFromListHint: Register from the session list first. After you are registered, you can add a note to the club here.
sessions.parentNoteHint: Optional. One-way to the club — for example pickup or a health reminder.
sessions.questionHint: The question is attached to this registration. You will see the admin reply here.
sessions.confirmation: This child is registered for the session.
sessions.noEligibleChild: There is no approved child who can register, or they are already registered.
sessions.registerSuccess: Registration complete. It appears under My registrations below.
sessions.timeZoneHint: Times are in the club time zone Asia/Taipei. Enter start and end, or start plus duration in minutes.
sessions.seriesTimeHint: Times are in the club time zone Asia/Taipei. The series start date is the first day to consider; selected weekdays plus the start time generate occurrences. Enter an end time or a duration.
sessions.createTeamsHint: Select at least one 梯隊. Each selected 梯隊 gets its own series or session with the same details.
sessions.weekdaysHint: Select every weekday this series meets. At least one is required. Do not rely on the series start date’s weekday alone.
sessions.playoffFlag: Mark this occurrence as a playoff
sessions.playoffHint: Playoff is a per-occurrence flag for league sessions. The club does not auto-generate a playoff bracket.
sessions.playoffCreateHint: After the regular-season series is created, you can mark individual occurrences as playoff. No playoff bracket is generated automatically.
sessions.recurrenceHint: Fill either an end date or a week count, not both. Week count N means N occurrences per selected weekday, including the first of that weekday. Maximum 52 sessions per create.
sessions.weekCount: Occurrences per weekday (including the first of each)
sessions.closedSignup: This session is inactive, deleted, or has ended, so it is not open for new signup.

competitions.title: Competitions
competitions.lead: Register an approved child for cup, league, and friendly matches on their team. Same team, kind, and title are grouped as a series so you can attend eligible fixtures or cancel cancellable ones together. The public visitor schedule stays on Matches. You cannot cancel within 24 hours of kickoff. Switch between calendar and list views.
competitions.emptyUpcomingBody: When an admin creates a cup, league, or friendly match for your child’s team, it appears here.
competitions.needApprovedChild: Link a child and wait for admin approval before you can register for competitions.
competitions.emptyRegistrationsBody: Open a series above and register a child.
competitions.bulkPartial: Some fixtures were updated. Check each row.
competitions.bulkNone: No fixtures were updated. Check each reason.
competitions.registerFromListHint: Register from the series list first. After that you can add a note for the club here.

credits.title: Credits
credits.lead: See remaining prepaid credits and sessions attended for approved children. Fee-paying bands can buy 10 / 20 / 30 packs: transfer using the club instructions, then enter the last five digits. Credits land only after an admin approves. Parents do not see the full money ledger.
credits.emptyChildrenBody: Credits appear after an admin approves the guardian link.
credits.lowBalance: Credits are low (≤1). Please renew soon and copy the transfer instructions.
credits.noDebitBand: This team does not debit prepaid credits (U6, reserve, or adult).
credits.buyLead: Pick a package and child, transfer using the instructions, then enter the last five digits. There is no in-app card payment.
credits.buyEmpty: No approved child can buy credits, or no matching package is active. U6, reserve, and adult teams do not use prepaid credits.
credits.packageHint: Primary packs are 10 / 20 / 30. Single-session prices exist for display and contribution math.
credits.transferHintMissing: Ask the club for the transfer account (it is not stored in source). Admins can fill BANK_TRANSFER_HINT on the credit admin page.
credits.last5: Last 5 digits of the transfer account
credits.emptyClaimsBody: Submitted claims appear here. Credits are added only after approval.
credits.adminClaimsLead: Approving adds the package credits to the player balance and writes the ledger. Coaches cannot see transfer amounts or last-5 digits. Never commit a real account number to git.
credits.emptyPendingClaimsBody: Parent last-5 claims appear here after they submit.
credits.adminCreditsLead: Maintain prices from 2026-09-01, adjust balances, and write parent-facing transfer instructions. Real bank details belong in local .env.local, Supabase secrets, or this admin field — not git.
credits.parentContribution: Parent contribution (approved claim amounts) NT$ {amount} · {count} claims
credits.playerContribution: Player contribution (debited sessions × unit cost) NT$ {amount} · {count} debits
credits.transferHintAdminHelp: You may include bank code and account hints. Do not paste LINE tokens or service-role keys. The BANK_TRANSFER_HINT env var is the fallback when this field is empty.
credits.adjustAmountHint: Positive adds credits; negative removes them. The balance cannot go negative.
credits.noticeLead: Copy, then paste manually into existing LINE groups. This app does not send LINE messages or push notifications.
credits.debitOverride: Debit this many credits (blank = kind default)
credits.debitOverrideHint: Regular present defaults to 1; regular unexcused does not debit. Special present or unexcused is 2; cup, league, and friendly competing players debit 1 per day. U6, reserve, and adult never debit.

matches.title: Match schedule
matches.lead: Upcoming and recent cup, league, and friendly matches. Lineups show display names and jersey numbers only.
matches.upcomingEmptyBody: When the club publishes a cup, league, or friendly match, it appears here. Unpublished and cancelled matches stay private.
matches.recentEmptyBody: Completed matches from the last 90 days appear here after they are published.
matches.opponentHint: Leave blank if the opponent is not known yet. You can fill it in later without recreating the session.
matches.lineupEmptyBody: The club has not published a roster for this match.
matches.notesPrivateHint: Staff notes stay on the session record and are never shown on the public match page.
matches.cancelConfirm: Cancel “{title}”? It will disappear from the public schedule. The training session is not deleted.
matches.cancelledBanner: This match is cancelled. It is hidden from the public schedule. Restore it to edit and publish again.
matches.softDeleteMatchConfirm: Delete “{title}”? It leaves the default admin and parent lists and the public schedule. This is not the same as Cancel. Roster and history are kept.
matches.matchDeletedBanner: This match is soft-deleted. It is hidden from default admin and parent lists and from the public schedule, even if it was cancelled. Roster and history stay on the session tools page.
matches.staffRosterHint: The published public match roster. Separate from parent RSVPs above.
matches.parentRegistrationsHint: Parent RSVPs from the competitions signup page. This is not the public lineup.
matches.parentRegistrationsEmptyBody: When a parent registers an approved child for this match, they appear here with notes and Q&A.
matches.rosterEmptyTitle: No active players on this team
matches.rosterEmptyBody: Add team memberships first, then choose who appears on the public lineup.
matches.attachLead: This cup, league, or friendly session is not a public match yet. Add home/away (and opponent if known) to create a public match page. Writes stay admin-only.
matches.coachReadOnly: Public match (read-only). Admins publish the lineup and result.
matches.bulkLead: Add several kickoff times. Each selected team gets those kickoffs independently. Opponent can stay blank. Matches stay unpublished unless you tick publish.
matches.bulkCountHint: At most {max} matches in one save. Empty rows are ignored.
matches.createTeamsHint: Select at least one 隊伍. Each selected 隊伍 gets its own match with the same title, kickoff, and other details.

assessments.title: Ability assessments
assessments.lead: Coaches and admins record development scores for players. Approved guardians can read only their linked children. Ability details are never public.
assessments.staffEmptyBody: Admins see every player. Coaches see players on assigned teams.
assessments.parentEmptyBody: After an admin approves a guardian link, that child’s assessments appear here.
assessments.createLead: Score four match situations and four traits from 1 to 5. Notes are optional. CTFA behaviour items are hints only and are not scored.
assessments.historyLead: Each saved assessment is kept as history. There is no one-row-forever limit.
assessments.historyEmptyBody: When a coach or admin records an assessment, it appears here.
assessments.editLead: You can update these scores or delete this assessment.
assessments.readOnlyLead: This view is read-only. Parents cannot create or edit assessments.
assessments.deleteConfirm: Delete this assessment? This cannot be undone.
assessments.assessedOnHint: Club calendar date (Asia/Taipei). Defaults to today.
assessments.situationsLead: One overall score per situation. Use the hints as guidance, not as extra scored fields.
assessments.ctfaDisclaimer: These short hints follow a youth “complete player” idea. They are guidance only — not official CTFA certification, and they are not scored.

attack: First touch and control when receiving
Choose to pass, dribble, or shoot
Move into space off the ball
defense: Stay with the marker and see the ball
Time the tackle; do not dive in
attack_to_defense: Press or recover as soon as possession is lost
defense_to_attack: First pass after winning the ball
Support quickly in front of the ball
Switch play when the press is beaten

import.confirmHint: Upload only parses. Rows stay off the roster until you confirm. Create-only: duplicates and jersey clashes block that row.
import.suggestionsHint: Suggestions are editable. Saving uses the existing match create path. Unpublished by default unless you tick publish. HTML is not stored.

leads.players: Required: English given + family, birth date, 梯隊 name or id, 梯隊 jersey, and at least one of Traditional Chinese or Japanese. Optional 隊伍 + jersey. Duplicate = same English names + birth date.
leads.coaches: Required: an existing profile phone (E.164) or profile id. Import will not create login accounts. Optional team names/ids to assign after linking.
leads.matches: Required: 隊伍 name or id, title, kind (cup / league / friendly), starts_at (Asia/Taipei). Opponent may be blank (TBD). is_published defaults to false. Training kinds are rejected.
leads.url: Paste a public http(s) fixture page. Private, localhost, and cloud-metadata addresses are blocked. Timeout 8s, max 1 MB. Edit the suggested fields, then save.

errors.duplicatePlayer: A player with the same English given name, family name, and birth date already exists.
errors.duplicateInFile: This row duplicates an earlier row in the same file.
errors.unknownProfilePhone: No existing profile matches that phone (or profile id). Coaches must already have signed in; import does not create login accounts.
errors.coachAlreadyLinked: That profile is already linked as a coach. Import is create-only.
errors.ambiguousTeamName: More than one unit has that name. Use the id column.
errors.importEmpty: The file has no data rows.
errors.importTooLarge: The file is too large or has too many rows (max 1 MB / 200 rows).
errors.importInvalidFile: Could not read that file. Use the CSV or Excel template.
errors.importNoValidRows: There are no valid rows to import. Fix the preview errors first.
errors.importHeaderInvalid: The header row does not match the template. Download a fresh template.
errors.blockedUrl: That URL is not allowed. Use a public http(s) page; private, localhost, and metadata addresses are blocked.
errors.urlFetchFailed: Could not fetch that page (size, type, or HTTP error).

notices.title: Notice copy
notices.lead: Generate a short LINE-group message and app deep links, then copy and paste into existing parent groups. This app does not send LINE, SMS, or push. The app is the source of truth; LINE is only a reminder.
notices.teamPlaceholder: Choose a 梯隊 or 隊伍
notices.gatherPlaceholder: e.g. 17:30 at the gate (omit if blank)
notices.recapPlaceholder: Short note — do not include parent names or phones
notices.dualPasteHint: This 隊伍 spans two 梯隊 parent groups. Copy each block into the matching LINE group. The app link is the same.
notices.noSourceBody: Choose a training session or match to generate copy. You can also open this page from session or match detail.
notices.noPiiHint: Group copy never includes parent names or phone numbers. Do not paste personal data into the note fields.
notices.noSendHint: Generate and copy only. No push, LINE Messaging API, SMS, or official-account send.
notices.coexistHint: Bank-transfer and debit notice copy stay on the session detail “Copy notice” panel. This page does not replace them.
